description: The Mourning Café, LLC is a veteran-owned grief coaching and life transition company that helps individuals navigate loss with compassion, hope, and practical support. Through one-on-one coaching, support groups, workshops, speaking engagements, and educational resources, we empower people to process grief and embrace healing using our signature L.I.V.E. Framework®—Let Yourself Feel, Identify Support, Value Your Journey, and Embrace New Beginnings. Our mission is to help people Grieve Out Loud.
hours: schedule a discovery call at https://calendly.com/themourningcafe
discount: Special offers for Veterans only-2 free coaching calls in addition to discovery call.
